rationale: Sam's expertise in software integration and tooling for autonomous vehicle development complements Hongye's work building autonomous systems at Allbotz. Both work at the intersection of robotics and autonomous systems, where Sam's infrastructure and integration background could help Allbotz scale their technical foundation.
intro_message: Sam Morstein, meet Hongye (Hades) Li — Sam builds integration tooling for autonomous vehicles at Applied Intuition, and Hongye is CEO of Allbotz, an autonomous systems company; worth connecting on the technical infrastructure side of robotics development.
